decisions.reason: WIN is a conventional compact race-result label; source and target match exactly and no embedded rule requires localization.
Cuộc đua Huyền thoại hằng ngày faithfully renders 每日传奇比赛 and is natural Vietnamese; only target length is flagged.
The current wording is awkward; this preserves the remaining-until-unlock meaning of 距解锁还剩 in more natural compact Vietnamese.
Có thể mở khóa! accurately preserves the positive availability message 可解锁！ and its emphasis.
The current target uses the explicitly forbidden calque khai hoa tài năng. The revised counter wording preserves the remaining requirement while using the canonical mechanic name.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term system.talent_bloom.localize requires the exact accepted label Talent Bloom and forbids Khai hoa tài năng/Nở rộ tài năng.
